title: Getting started with Taskify
description: Learn how to set up your first project, invite your team, assign tasks and track progress in the Taskify app for Android and iOS.
introduction: Start with one project and a few clearly defined tasks. Give each task an owner and a deadline, then keep its status up to date so your team can see what needs attention.

steps.title: Create your Taskify account
steps.description: Open the Android or iOS app, sign up with your email address and complete email verification with the one-time code sent to you.
items: Use an email address you can access so you can receive verification and password-reset codes.
If the verification email does not arrive, check your spam folder and confirm that the address you entered is correct.

steps.title: Set up your first project
steps.description: Create a project for a specific piece of work, such as a website update or a product release. A project keeps related tasks and people together.
items: Choose a name your team will recognise and set the project deadline if the work has one.
Use the project to group tasks that contribute to the same outcome. You can archive it when the work is finished.

steps.title: Bring your team into the project
steps.description: Create a team, invite its members and share the project with the people doing the work. Team leaders help keep membership and responsibilities organised.
items: Check that the people who need to contribute are members of the team or project.
Agree who will own each task before assigning work, so everyone knows what they are responsible for.

steps.title: Create and assign a task
steps.description: Choose the project in the task-creation screen, add a clear title and description, then set the due date, priority and assignees.
items: Write a title that describes an action, such as "Review the landing page copy".
Use the description to explain the expected result and any details your team needs.
Set a due date and reminder when timing matters. Choose the priority based on how urgent the work is.
Add the people responsible for the task, save it, and check the project and assignees in the confirmation.

image.alt: Taskify task-creation preview showing a project selector, title, description, due date, reminder, priority and assignees
image.caption: Task creation preview: put the task details and ownership in one place.

steps.title: Review details and follow progress
steps.description: Open the task details and keep the status current as work moves from To do through In progress, Review and Testing to Completed.
items: After creating a task, check its project, deadline and assignees before starting work.
Update the status as the work progresses so teammates can see what is ready for review or testing.
Mark work completed when it has met the agreed requirements. Use the activity history to follow changes.

image.alt: Taskify task-confirmation preview showing the created task, project, due date, priority and assigned team members
image.caption: Task confirmation preview: check the deadline, priority and assigned team.

steps.title: Keep the conversation with the task
steps.description: Use task comments and attachments to share updates and the files your team needs. Activity updates and notifications help you follow changes without chasing separate messages.
items: Add a comment when you need clarification or want to explain a status change.
Attach relevant files to the task so teammates can find them alongside the discussion.
Review notifications and activity updates for changes that affect your work.

troubleshooting.title: Waiting for a verification email?
troubleshooting.description: Check the email address you used and your spam folder. If verification is still blocked, contact Taskify support with a description of what happened.

troubleshooting.title: Cannot find a shared project?
troubleshooting.description: Confirm that you are signed in with the account invited to the project. Ask your team leader to check your membership and whether the project has been shared with you.

troubleshooting.title: Need help with a bug?
troubleshooting.description: Tell support what you were doing, what happened, your device's Android or iOS version and your Taskify app version.
